biography: I am a Data Scientist from North Hesse working with time-series data, clustering, and large-scale data processing. My interests include distributed computing and high-performance computing, with Python, scikit-learn, and SciPy among my primary tools.

Alongside my work at Viessmann Climate Solutions, I am pursuing a doctorate in Computer Science at Philipps-Universität Marburg. I previously worked as a Software Engineer in full-stack development and still enjoy systems and software engineering, including programming in Rust.
contactText: I’m interested in thoughtful conversations about data science, time series, clustering, distributed computing, and HPC.
